PNB is the market leader for unit trust business in Malaysia. PNB’s objective is to provide excellent unit trust services, innovative solutions for their customers and agents as well. The scope of work is to enhance  current .net version of FCIS application to FCIS 14.4.0.0.0 base product with functionalities required for PNB.
The first chapter of this document gives an introduction with brief background and organization of the document.  Subsequent chapters cover the details of the actual enhancements.

The enhancements scoped in the document are relating to the Non-Financial load Enhancement that were customized for PNB as part of .net enhancements. The Details are covered in the Traceability Matrix section. The summary of requirements is as below:
SST on Non-financial load and BNM rounding
GAP/New requirements are not part of this FS, these new Gaps will be discussed separately in detail and cover in different FS.

System needs to parameterize the non-financial fees to be levied to customer per transaction.  While setting up the fees, when the fee is to be paid by unit holder, user should be able to indicate the fees to be collected from the unit holder or to be recovered from units.

GST (SST) is applicable for Non-Financial Services also where fee is collected. To cater GST (SST) and BNM rounding applicability on NFL services, NFL Maintenance will be enhanced to capture GST (SST) and BNM rounding applicability
Transfer Fee to be charged for Transfer Transactions based on Transaction Channel and Fund Price Type
Existing AGYUH Status ChangeDetailUnit holder status change detail screen ‘UTDACCLS’ supports the user to mark the active unit holder as closed and mark closed Unit holder as Active.
If any additional criteria require to apply on the load for non-financial events should be discussed and enhanced separately
Reports related to Non-financial transactions such as ‘Transaction summary’ will be covered as part of separate report FDD.
GL related functionality and processing changes will be covered as part of separate FDD.
UH Info screen will not be available in J2EE, user can modify the UH record from unit holder maintenance screen
Following Non-financial events will be out of scope for upgrade in J2EE
Monthly statement request for details transactions
Quarterly statement request for details transactions

System will be enhanced to add new system parameter ‘NFLEVENT’ which will be displayed in field Event in FMGNon-Financial load maintenance Details (UTDNFLM) screen, following parameter codes will be maintained:

System will be enhanced to add a new screen ‘Non-Financial load maintenance Details’ in FMG Non-Financial load maintenance Details  (UTDNFLM) screen for setting up loads for non-financial transactions. Screen fields are detailed below:
The following operations will be supported in FMGNon-Financial load maintenance Details  screen (UTDNFLM):

New: user can create new Non-Financial load setup by clicking on New button, once new button is clicked, system allows the user to enter the require fields to create new Non-financial load setup and allow to save it
View: user has two option to retrieve the existing record to view, one in summary screen and another is from main screen

Summary screen: user can provide the values in search fields and click on search button, based on search criteria, system fetches the result and display the records in body section, user can double click the record from summary screen, system opens the main screen, user can view all details

User can just enter the function ID which is screen ID in the top right corner like (UTDNFLM) and press enter or  arrow, system open main screen, user can click on Enter query button and provide key values in the main screen and then click on Execute query, based on key values system retrieve the record and display it

Authorize new: once the record is created by a maker, checker can search the record either from summary screen or main screen and click on ‘Authorize’ button, record will be authorize, un-authorize records remain in system until the record is authorized or deleted
Note: checker does not have option to reject the un-authorize record

Delete: user can delete only un-authorize records and only maker can delete the created records, first search the record either through summary screen or main screen and click on ‘Delete button’ on top left corner in main screen, record will be deleted from system, authorized records cannot be deleted.

Copy: If user want to create a new Non-Financial load setup with the same attributes of an existing maintenance, user can copy the attributes of an existing Non-Financial load setup record to a new one, first search existing record through summary screen or main screen, once the record is open from main screen click on ‘Copy’ button from top left corner, all attributes gets copy except event and Load ID, these two fields will be blank, then user can select the event and load ID and change the requires values in other fields and save the record, subsequently checker can authorize the record
A new Non-Financial load maintenance Summary (UTSNFLM) screen will be introduced in FMG  Non-financial load maintenance Summary (UTSNFLM) and it will have the following search fields:
Event code: system will display LOV of Event
Load ID: System will display list of Load IDs for which Non-Financial load is created
From Entity: Entity types (Agent, AMC, Unit holder)
To Entity: Entity types (Agent, AMC, Unit holder)
Recover Units: it will show three option as All, Yes, No
System display the list of records in body section based on the search criteria provided in header section, user can double click the record and system will open the main ‘Non-financial load’ screen
A new Non-financial load maintenance Summary (UTSNFLM) screen will support J2EE standard product functions:

Non-financial load can be mapped to agents in Non-Financial load maintenance Details screen If any one of the entities either ‘from’ or ‘to’ is an Agent, then Agent Code becomes mandatory, a grid will be available in non-financial load maintenance  screen where user can select multiple agents for an event, here agent is agency branch module Agent, if any Agency branch performs Non-financial events and this Agency Branch module Agent is mapped to these Non-financial load as ‘To’ entity, then this agent will get benefit of Non-financial load,

System will be enhanced to add new criteria in FMGLoad maintenance (UTDLOADM) screen which will be used to create criteria load and map as Non-financial load for event ‘Transfer’, new criteria as detailed below
Using the above criteria user can setup the criteria load based on Transaction Channel and Fund Price Type, as shown below:
All the Transaction Channel for all the Transactions other than OTC are considered as Online (Non-OTC)
Once the above loads are created in FMGLoad maintenance (UTDLOADM)screen, user can map these loads to event ‘Transfer’ in Non-Financial load maintenance Detail (UTDNFLM) screen
FMGNon financial Load maintenance summary (UTSNFLM) screen
Though the multiple events maintained under param code ‘NFLEVENT’, system will support only following Non-financial events for which system will calculate the Fee/commission and store in the table
UH Info change (Modification of UH Record)-only information change as given below
UH account closure due to non-eligibility

First user has to create the load in FMGLoad maintenance (UTDLOADM) screen and map these loads to events in FMGNon-Financial load (UTDNFLM) screen with additional details such as from Entity, to Entity, SST applicability and Agent code if applicable

System will trigger calculation of fee/commission when the event is authorized using the load mapped to that event, some of these loads will not be deducted from unit holder balance or paid to any entity in FCIS system, it will be log and store in table.
Assume fee is set as RM 3.00

UH is created by the maker in UH creation screen when checker authorized the UH, system will calculate the fee as RM.3.00 which will not impact on UH balance and these Fee will be logged and stored in table.
Assume fee is set as RM 5.00

Maker makes the amendments to UH ( ) when checker authorized the UH amendments, system will calculate the fee as RM.5.00 which will not impact on UH balance and these Fee will be logged and stored in table.
Assume fee is set as RM 7.00

Maker mark the UH as closed in unit holder status change detail UTDACCLS screen when checker authorized it, system will calculate the fee as RM.7.00 which will not impact on UH balance and these Fee will be logged and stored in table.
Assume fee is set as RM 5.00

when Transmission beneficiary details are captured in Transmission screen, system will calculate the fee as RM.5.00 and during EOD batch the job ‘First Transmission processing’ which will trigger the redemption transaction per fund which will have amount equal to fee RM 5.00 which will be deducted from UH balance from each fund.
Assume fee is set as RM 4.00

Maker mark the UH as Deceased in UH screen UTDUHFT and fill the initial khairat details in same UH lite screen when checker authorized these UH ‘Initial Khairat’ changes, system will calculate the fee as RM.4.00 which will not be deducted from initial khairat amount, or
If maker fill the khairat details in UH khairat subs screen and when checker authorized it, system will calculate the fee as RM.4.00 which will not be deducted from initial khairat amount.
Assume fee is set as RM 10.00

When user attaches the RPO code ‘Insolvent’ to a UH in UH lite screen UTDUHFT and tag the UH in UH fund suspension screen in AGY UH fund suspension screen UTDFDSUS with reason as Insolvent, after 14 days( days can be Parameterized) system will calculate the fee as RM.10.00 and create redemption transaction of amount RM 10.00 which will be reduced from UH balance.
Assume fee is set as RM 5.00
When Holding statement is generated from statement request maintenance screen that time system will calculate the fee and store in table, it will not impact on UH balance,
Similarly, if below non-financial load events are setup then system will calculate the fee when statements are requested and generated from statement request maintenance screen

Non-financial load for Transfer: Once the Criteria load is created based on the fund type and transaction channels, user will map the load to event ‘Transfer’ in Non-financial load maintenance screen and configure should be from entity as UH and TO entity as AMC,
When the transfer transaction is allocated for that particular fund type and transaction channel, system will calculate the fee and create the redemption transaction with same amount
This redemption transaction with ref type as ‘LF’ will be allocated on same day with same day NAV and same number of units will be deducted from transferor unit balance

Sales and Services Tax (SST): SST will be applied on Non-financial load amount if SST applicable field is set as Yes and SST rate is configured in Non-Financial load maintenance Details  (UTDNFLM) screen
system will calculate the SST based on SST rate on Non-financial load where SST is applicable, for example
System calculate the SST only to those unit holders whose ’SST Exempted’ field is un-checked in Unit Holder Detail FT Maintenance Screen
System will not calculate the SST to those unit holders whose ’GST Exempted’ field is checked in Unit Holder Detail FT Maintenance Screen
BNM Rounding: System will be enhanced to perform the rounding based on the BNM rounding logic and it will be applied on all Non-financial loads

BNM rounding logic will be applied to the final total amount of the transaction inclusive of SST. The actual SST amount will not be affected by rounding. The rounding gain or loss will be absorbed by ASNB.

If the total amount of a bill (including sales and services subject to tax) that ends in 1, 2, 6 and 7 sen, will be rounded downwards and 3, 4, 8 and 9 sen will be rounded upwards to the nearest multiple of 5 sen. This rounding mechanism will be applicable to all over the counter cash payments, below tables explain of NB round
BNM Rounding will be applied on the Transaction based Load  at the time of Calculating fee.
SST will be computed and BNM rounding logic will applied for Non-financial load as mention below
SST will be computed and BNM rounding logic will applied for Non-financial load ‘Transfer’ as mention below
After BNM rounding, system will create the redemption transaction for amount 16.45 and same amount will be deducted from transferor UH balance
Bulk Upload/External Interface / Gateway / Scheduler changes
Report or BO Universe or BI Changes
Transaction summary report which has the section – “FORM SUBMISSION SUMMARY’ which displays fund and teller-wise counts for various Non-Financial transactions will be part of Separate Report FDD
Base FS documents from .net as mentioned in Traceability matrix.

tables.preceding_paragraph_text: System will be enhanced to add new system parameter ‘NFLEVENT’ which will be displayed in field Event in FMGNon-Financial load maintenance Details (UTDNFLM) screen, following parameter codes will be maintained:

rows: Event on which the fee/incentive/commission to be calculated. System will show the LOV of Events maintained under param code ‘NFLEVENT’
LOV will show the Load ID's created in system in Load maintenance UTDLOADM screen, user can select the appropriate Load ID which is to be mapped to this event.
It will be used to specify the entity to which the load will be applied. The LOV will show only three entities Agent, AMC and Unit holder
It will be used to specify the entity which will be benefited by the load applied. The LOV will show only three entities Agent, AMC and Unit holder
It will be used to specify SST is applicable or not
This field will be enabled and becomes Mandatory if SST applicable field is set as Yes
It will be used to specify BNM Rounding is applicable or not
It will be used to specify whether the units to be recovered from unit holder, By default this will be disabled and will be editable only when the from entity is Unitholder.
This will be an optional agent code grid and it will become mandatory if any of the entities (From Entity or TO Entity) selected as Agent, LOV will show list of agents
